verdict.rationale: Square documents opening an account in a supported country and accepting in-person payments, either with Tap to Pay on iPhone or on Square hardware. The pack does not cover the approval process, how long onboarding takes, or ordering hardware from the dashboard. missing for 10: documented approval/underwriting flow and timeline, in-dashboard hardware ordering and shipping, evidence of going live within a week, independent hands-on onboarding reports.

support.subject: As a founder, I can sign up, get approved, and order hardware from the dashboard so I am taking in-person payments the same week

citations.quote: Accept contactless cards, Apple Pay, and other digital wallets in person with Tap to Pay on iPhone.
Process payments on Square hardware or online using any Internet-connected device.
you’re always welcome to open a new account and select any supported country.
